content.comment_body: Hello everyone! Could someone clarify if [product_name] allows data exchange between its program and a Modbus device during simulation, or is direct data transfer only possible when connected online to the actual PLC? Thank you!
[product_name] does not support communication with real devices when operating in simulation mode.

analysis.insight_summary: A user asked whether [product_name] could transfer data with Modbus devices while in simulation mode. The answer clarified that such communication is not possible until an online connection to hardware is established, highlighting a limitation in testing and integration before deployment.
analysis.user_expectations: The user hoped to connect with real Modbus devices during simulation using [product_name].
pain_keywords: no real device communication in simulation
